item.title: SwiftChat 0.1.0 (2) Alpha
item.description:
SwiftChat for macOS — first public alpha.
• A native Mac workspace for AI conversations and ChatGPT Web. • Connect supported model services with your own accounts. • Preview read-only context from Terminal, TextEdit, Notes and Xcode with Work with Apps. • Open ordinary pages in a separate native Browser window. • Signed and notarized universal macOS download, with Sparkle updates. • ChatGPT Web adapter source, alpha protocol and compatibility fixtures are now public under MIT.
Requires macOS 26 or later. SwiftChat remains closed source; the adapter is separately MIT licensed. ChatGPT integration is unofficial and may be affected by website changes. This alpha may include unfinished behavior; please report issues without private conversation content or credentials.
